profile.headline: Driving secure, visible, high-value outcomes for complex technology platforms and the clients who depend on them.
profile.summary:
Krys Howard is a technologist with 5+ years in enterprise technology, including Amazon, and 4+ years building financial systems at Morgan Stanley. His background spans Network Support, Robotics, Java and Python programming, payments infrastructure, cloud platforms, automation, and technical project delivery across global teams.

Krys builds secure, scalable solutions for critical, high-volume workflows where reliability, visibility, and operational resilience matter. In financial services, he supports event-processing systems integrated with enterprise payment hubs and the Federal Reserve, and develops automation on bespoke cloud platforms to streamline Treasury and Cash Management operations.

Krys’s strength is translating complexity into practical value: partnering with stakeholders, vendors, upstream technology teams, and business users to clarify problems, design workable solutions, and move technical initiatives forward. He is especially interested in logistics, industrial operations, manufacturing verticals and start-ups of all kinds — arenas where people and software improves how real-world systems move, produce, adapt, and scale.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Java Development · Data Modeling · Agile Methodologies · Quality Assurance Testing · Software Design

positions.title: Robotics Operator
positions.description:
Responsible for diagnosing, ticketing, and performing initial troubleshoot or reboot of both PODS and NIKE stations to resolve 80% of daily IT issues, exceeding 2021 quota by over 25%

Developed documentation for coaching Inbound staff (12+ per quarter) on managing scanner, monitor, and digitizer issues to increase hourly throughput. Obtained official trainer badge after leading first dozen trainees

Extensive daily communication with Robotics team, associates, management-level leaders and IT Operations to resolve a wide range of technology-related issues. Winter 2022’s Service Desk and Technology Teams review most successful in company history

Maintains robotics floor: clearing obstructions to maximize efficiency of PODS and 40 workstations daily
positions.insights: Skills: Software Troubleshooting · IT Hardware Support · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Robotics · Technical Support

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
Responsible for the BIOS storage configuration, imaging deployment, and physical set-up of 40+ thick clients and monitors to upgrade office system, infrastructure, and security requirements of the medical environment

Maintenance of server room: created and initiated labeling system of incoming critical devices to increase overall efficiency

Performed remote customization of eClinicalWorks platform for 100+ providers and staff to grow overall efficiency of medical documentation, billing, and processing of incoming patients.
positions.insights: Skills: Hardware Diagnostics · IT Hardware Support · Windows 10 · Active Directory · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Shift Supervisor
positions.description:
Provided exceptional customer service and dedicated time to embracing and embodying company motifs and culture, promoted to Shift Supervisor after 8 months of Barista work.

Created training documentation for the handling of point-of-sale machines and mobile devices in high pressure environment to increase overall store efficiency by upwards 12% during the Winter of 2016.

 Responsible for weekly inventory orders and peak/seasonal reports of holiday items’ in-store sales performance. Responsible for initial (first week) training of all incoming closing staff members.
positions.insights: Skills: Customer Service · Customer Experience · Team Management · Barista · Food Safety · Barista Training
